summary: Roosevelt NF, Larimer County CO tower built 1939 by CCC; cab removed 1978 to Fort Collins, moved 2011 to Running Deer Natural Area and open since 2012; summit has only ruins.

facts.design: L-4 cab on a timber tower
facts.status_note: Original tower was taken down in the 1970s and only a few ruins remain at the summit. The cab was moved to Running Deer Natural Area in 2011 and has been open to the public since 2012.

staffing.status: SummitPost staff list ends in 1967 (John and Marilyn Henthorne, 1966-1967); Forest Lookouts says the Forest Service decommissioned the lookout in 1978

access.note: Cab at Running Deer Natural Area is open to the public since 2012 per SummitPost and Forest Lookouts. Original summit has only ruins; SummitPost describes a long hike and no current source confirms that the route is open.

visit.trail_note: Running Deer Natural Area is a city natural area in Fort Collins; check the city's rules before going. The original summit is a long hike per SummitPost; no current source says whether it is open.

facts.agency: U.S. Forest Service (original site, Roosevelt National Forest); cab now looked after by Fort Collins Natural Areas staff

corrections.current: None relocated (The lookout was moved to Running Deer Natural Area.)
corrections.proposed: 1978 cab removed to Lee Martinez City Park, Fort Collins; 2011 moved to Running Deer Natural Area
corrections.why: The one-line note skips the 1978 removal and the Fort Collins park stop, so it reads as if the cab did not move until 2011.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The FFLOS page (registered 2009) says the cab is at CSU's Environmental Learning Center. SummitPost and Forest Lookouts say it moved to Running Deer Natural Area in August 2011. The later move is better documented and is the one used in the story.
SummitPost's staff list ends in 1967, while Forest Lookouts says the Forest Service decommissioned the lookout in 1978 and FFLOS says the tower was taken down in the 1970s. The story gives both.

SummitPost has the cab pass through CSU's Environmental Learning Center before Running Deer. Forest Lookouts goes straight from the Fort Collins park to Running Deer. Not resolved; the story reports both.

notes_for_editor: The 1939 build and the 2011 move to Running Deer are supported by at least two sources. The 1967 versus 1978 end-of-service dates and the CSU stop are disputed and are reported as disputed. The fcgov.com Running Deer page returned no readable text, so the current-site facts rest on SummitPost and Forest Lookouts, both community or hobby sites. Access to the summit road is unverified. No photos were added.
